provenance.dataset: Synthetic simulation generated at training time by data/train_risk_model.py. No real student records were used.
provenance.validation: Recorded metrics come from a single train/test split of the synthetic dataset. No cross-validation was used for these figures; values may vary between runs.
provenance.model_selection: Random Forest was fixed as the deployed artifact at first build and retained, although Logistic Regression scored higher on every recorded metric in this evaluation (including high-risk recall: 0.9915 vs 0.8644).
provenance.real_world_validation: None. The model has never been evaluated against real institutional data; these metrics do not represent expected real-world performance.
provenance.annotation_note: This provenance block was hand-annotated without retraining. Artifact files and recorded metric values are unchanged from the original build.
